newsitem.title: USA: Puget Sound Washington Energy respond.
newsitem.headline: Puget Sound Washington Energy respond.

text.p: Puget Sound Power & Light Co and Washington Energy Co said Thursday they believe certain conditions proposed by Washington state regulatory staff to the companies's planned merger are "unacceptable."
While they disagree with certain conditions, the staff's conclusion that their merger would benefit the public is "a substantial step forward," the companies said in a statement.
On Sept. 23, the staff of the Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission issued its recommendations to the regulatory body. The commission may accept, change or reject the recommendations.

In its report, the staff concluded electric and natural gas customers in western Washington should see a slight reduction in rates; however, they also showed concern over a possible deterioration in service.
The companies said they will detail their differences with the staff's recommendations in a rebuttal to be filed by October 11. Final briefs are due by December 6.
